title: T-SQL Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Ask for a message
examples.description: SELECT asks for a result. AS gives its column a name.

examples.title: Name a local number
examples.description: DECLARE makes a local variable. T-SQL variable names start with @.

examples.title: Join text values
examples.description: CONCAT joins values as text. It can also convert simple number inputs to text.

examples.title: Choose a result
examples.description: CASE returns a value from the first matching branch.
examples.code:
DECLARE @score int = 8;
SELECT CASE WHEN @score >= 5 THEN 'Pass' ELSE 'Try again' END AS message;

examples.title: Choose which statement runs
examples.description: IF controls which SQL statements run. BEGIN and END group statements.

examples.title: Make a small result table
examples.description: VALUES can create rows for a query. An alias names the tiny table and its column.
examples.code: SELECT n FROM (VALUES (3), (1), (2)) AS numbers(n) ORDER BY n;

examples.title: Keep matching rows
examples.description: WHERE keeps rows that pass a condition.
examples.code: SELECT n FROM (VALUES (4), (8), (9)) AS scores(n) WHERE n >= 7 ORDER BY n;

examples.title: Add values across rows
examples.description: SUM adds a column over the selected rows.
examples.code: SELECT SUM(n) AS total FROM (VALUES (2), (3), (4)) AS numbers(n);

examples.title: Choose a missing-value fallback
examples.description: COALESCE returns the first input that is not NULL.
examples.code:
DECLARE @name varchar(20) = NULL;
SELECT COALESCE(@name, 'Guest') AS name;

examples.title: Read a number safely
examples.description: TRY_CONVERT returns NULL when this text cannot be converted to int. COALESCE then supplies zero.

examples.title: Repeat with WHILE
examples.description: WHILE repeats its block while a rule stays true.

examples.title: Read a JSON field
examples.description: JSON_VALUE reads one simple value from JSON text using a path.
